rationales: Client-server overuse is unauthorized use of server software beyond its permitted number of users.
Online piracy is copying or distributing software through the internet.
Counterfeiting is making and selling fake copies of software or its packaging.
Hard disk loading is installing unauthorized software copies on computers before selling them.
A diamond represents a decision in a flowchart.
A parallelogram represents input or output in a flowchart.
A rectangle represents processing in a flowchart.
A connector links separated parts of a flowchart.
16 bits is too short for an IPv6 address.
32 bits is the length of an IPv4 address, not IPv6.
An IPv6 address consists of 128 bits.
255 is not the number of bits in an IPv6 address.
A matrix is a rectangular arrangement of values, not a representation of an algorithm.
A graph is not the standard diagram used to represent an algorithm.
A flowchart graphically represents an algorithm.
A solution is the result of solving a problem, not a graphical representation.
The <h1> tag is used for the most important heading.
The <h5> tag is for a lower-level heading.
The <h2> tag is for a second-level heading.
The <h3> tag is for a third-level heading.
The binary representation of decimal 15 is 1111.
10010 is the binary representation of decimal 18.
10011 is the binary representation of decimal 19.
10000 is the binary representation of decimal 16.
IP is an addressing protocol, not the protocol used to send email.
SMTP is used to send email between systems.
HTTP is primarily used to transfer web pages.
FTP is used to transfer files, not to send email.
<dl> is a valid definition-list tag in HTML.
<ol> is a valid ordered-list tag in HTML.
<ml> is not a valid HTML list tag.
<ul> is a valid unordered-list tag in HTML.
P=Q expresses equality, not the AND operation.
P/Q represents division, not the AND operation.
P+Q commonly represents OR in Boolean algebra.
P.Q represents the AND operation in Boolean algebra.
Liability is not a type of software piracy.
Soft lifting is a type of software piracy involving unauthorized copying or sharing.
Online piracy involves illegally obtaining or distributing software online.
Client-server overuse is a type of software piracy involving excess users of a server license.
Invalid test data is used to check how a program handles unacceptable input.
Valid test data is used to check acceptable input.
Positive test data is a recognized category of test data.
Absent test data is not generally listed as a standard type of test data.
A star topology can be disrupted if its central device fails.
A bus topology depends on a shared backbone cable.
A mesh topology is highly reliable because devices have multiple paths between them.
A ring topology can be disrupted by a link or device failure.
The problem-solving process is commonly described in seven steps.
Five is fewer than the commonly taught seven steps.
Three is fewer than the commonly taught seven steps.
Two is fewer than the commonly taught seven steps.
The <i> tag is used to italicize text.
The <b> tag is used to bold text.
The <u> tag is used to underline text.
The <font> tag was used to set text color in older HTML.
DOS refers to a type of operating system or a denial-of-service attack, not illegal copying of software.
Hacking is unauthorized access to or manipulation of computer systems.
Phishing is a fraudulent attempt to obtain sensitive information.
Piracy is the illegal copying or distribution of software.
